source_citation: NASA GSFC / IEEE Aerospace: Lessons Learned from Dellingr: NASA GSFC's First 6U CubeSat (2018)
narrative_summary: Following deployment from the International Space Station, NASA's Dellingr 6U CubeSat suffered a UHF radio transmitter software freeze and lockup. Spacecraft recovery was achieved through an autonomous flight software power-cycle watchdog that executed periodic hard system resets.

events.description: UHF transmitter command receiver lockup after initial ISS deployment
events.notes: Documented in NASA GSFC Lessons Learned report; exact initial lockup Δt is normalized for simulation.

events.description: Flight software 24-hour autonomous watchdog countdown trip
events.notes: NASA documented hardwired recovery reset designed to clear communication lockups.

events.description: EPS main power bus commanded system-wide power cycle
OBC reboot and flight software clean restart

events.description: UHF transmitter recovery and nominal ground station beacon restored
events.notes: NASA GSFC ground station confirmed successful beacon acquisition post-reset.
